description: Republican members of the Kansas Congressional delegation today announced they endorse Kris Kobach for Kansas Attorney General. Congressman Ron Estes, Jake Laturner, and Tracey Mann came together today to support Kobach in the general election.

title: Kansas Republican Congressional Delegation Endorses Kris Kobach | Kris Kobach for Attorney General
